mapper.select: SELECT M.NAME AS name, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS departmentName, P.POSITION_NAME AS positionName, M.EMAIL AS email, NVL(ROUND(AVG(PROG.PROGRESS_RATE)), 0) AS avgProgressRate FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = M.DEPARTMENT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = M.POSITION_ID LEFT JOIN ENROLLMENT E ON E.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND E.STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CP.ENROLLMENT_ID, ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN CP.IS_COMPLETED = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 ) AS PROGRESS_RATE FROM CHAPTER_PROGRESS CP GROUP BY CP.ENROLLMENT_ID ) PROG ON PROG.ENROLLMENT_ID = E.ENROLLMENT_ID WHERE M.STATUS = 'Y' AND M.ROLE = 'N' GROUP BY M.MEMBER_ID, M.NAME, D.DEPARTMENT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, M.EMAIL ORDER BY avgProgressRate ASC
